objective: RULER-20261111-001 direction 1 (G1, question 9), at the coordinator's go-ahead of 2026-11-11 under the owner's standing mandate: carry the plane ruler (bond distance = graph distance + 1 under the not-all-equal knot) to 6-regular tori and Klein bottles.
